title: 第16章 重返黑水城，怒惩黑虎帮
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
苏余在遗迹中没有多留。

    苏白石送他到传送阵前，临别时从袖中取出一枚玉简塞进他手里。

    “时族除了时间祖炁之外，还有一套自己的体修法门。

    当年时族子弟在修时间法则之前，都要先练这套拳法打熬筋骨。

    你现在有时之种强化肉身，这套拳法对你的裨益会更大。

    里面还有一张地图，标注了黑风岭中三处时族遗物的位置。

    三处遗物各有用处——一处是时族演武场，里面残留的时痕可以帮你加速强化肉身；一处是时族药圃，虽然荒废了数千年，但有些灵药的种子被时间封印封存在地下深处，只有时之共鸣才能找到它们；最后一处是时族剑冢，藏有时族历代剑修的本命飞剑。

    这三处遗物都有时族禁制保护，外人找不到，即便碰巧路过也打不开。

    只有时之共鸣才能定位，只有时族血脉才能开启。”

    苏余接过玉简，对苏白石抱拳行了一礼。

    “去吧。

    传送阵只能再用一次，把你送出去之后遗迹就会彻底关闭。

    传送阵的出口是你进来时的原位。”

    苏余抬脚迈入传送阵。

    金光吞没了他的视野。

    等他再睁开眼时，他站在北墙根废弃地窖里。

    头顶的烂草席还在，周围的黄土墙还在，地上阵图的焦痕还在。

    唯一不同的是——地窖入口被掘开了，从外面透进来的火把光芒将洞内照得通明。

    “里面的人，出来！”

    一个低沉沙哑的声音从洞口传来。

    苏余抬头看去，洞口外站着一圈人。

    最前面的是个四十来岁的男人，穿黑虎帮的管事袍，炼气九层，腰挎一把沉重的开山斧。

    他身后跟着十几个黑虎帮帮众，个个手持兵器，把地窖入口围得水泄不通。

    更远处的窝棚区里，苏余看见了石头——被两个黑虎帮的人按在地上，脸上青紫一片，嘴角还在渗血。

    他旁边，小禾被一个帮众拎着后领提在半空，小女孩咬着嘴唇，没有哭。

    苏余的目光落在黑虎帮管事身上，然后又扫过石头脸上的伤和小禾被拎起的身影。

    他没说什么，只是站起身来拍拍身上的泥土，从地窖里爬了出来。

    “就是你？”

    管事上下打量着苏余，目光在他腰间两把刀和背上的寒霜剑上停留了片刻，“之前有兄弟报告，说这一带出现了异光。

    我们的人搜遍了窝棚区，发现这间地窖里有灵力残留。

    说吧，你在下面藏了什么？”

    苏余没有回答他的问题。

    他看了一眼石头，又看了一眼小禾，然后问管事：“那俩小孩，你打的？”

    管事皱了皱眉：“我问你话。

    这俩耗子是窝棚区的流浪儿，欠我帮的保护费没交，教训一下怎么了？”

    “保护费？”

    苏余的声音很平淡，“黑水城什么时候有了保护费这个名目？”

    “黑虎帮定的规矩，轮得到你一个外人来管？”

    管事冷笑一声，“小子，我看你不是本地人。

    识相的就把地窖里藏的东西交出来，我或许还能留你一命。

    若是敢反抗——”

    苏余没有等他说完。

    他动了。

    不是冲向管事，而是直接冲入了黑虎帮人群之中。

    融合时之种后的速度比之前快了至少三成，加上肉身四阶强化，十几个炼气二三层的帮众在他眼中就像静止的靶子。

    他从第一个帮众腰间拔出刀的同时，刀背已经砸在了第二个帮众的膝盖上；第三个人的锁链还没甩开，他的膝盖已经顶在了对方的肋下；第四个人刚举起弩箭，弩机被他一把夺过反手砸在第五个人的面门上。

    五息。
content_en:
Su Yu didn't stay long in the ruins.

    Su Baishi sent him to the teleportation array, and when leaving, he took out a jade slip from his sleeve and stuffed it into his hand.

    “In addition to the Time Ancestral Qi, the Shi Clan also has its own body cultivation method.

    Back then, before the children of the Shi clan could practice the law of time, they had to practice this set of boxing techniques to break their muscles and bones.

    Now that you have the opportunity to strengthen your physical body, this boxing technique will be of greater benefit to you.

    There is also a map inside, marking the locations of three Time Clan relics in Black Wind Ridge.

    The three relics each have their own uses - one is the Time Clan martial arts field, where the traces of time remaining can help you accelerate the strengthening of your body; the other is the Time Clan medicine garden, although it has been abandoned for thousands of years, but the seeds of some elixirs have been sealed by time and stored deep underground, and only the Resonance of Time can find them; the last place is the Time Clan Sword Tomb, which contains the natal flying swords of the Time Clan sword cultivators of all generations.

    These three relics are protected by the Toki Clan's prohibitions. Outsiders cannot find them and cannot open them even if they happen to pass by.

    Only the resonance of time can be located, and only the bloodline of the time clan can be opened. "

    Su Yu took the jade slip and saluted Su Baishi with clasped fists.

    "Go ahead.

    The teleportation array can only be used once. After sending you out, the ruins will be completely closed.

    The exit of the teleportation array is where you were when you entered. "

    Su Yu raised his feet and stepped into the teleportation array.

    Golden light engulfed his vision.

    When he opened his eyes again, he was standing in the abandoned cellar at the base of the north wall.

    The rotten straw mat above the head is still there, the surrounding loess walls are still there, and the scorch marks on the formation map on the ground are still there.

    The only difference is that the entrance to the cellar has been dug, and the light from the torches coming in from the outside illuminates the cave.

    "People inside, come out!"

    A low and hoarse voice came from the entrance of the cave.

    Su Yu looked up and saw a circle of people standing outside the cave entrance.

    The one at the front is a man in his forties, wearing the steward robe of the Black Tiger Gang, with a ninth level of Qi refining, and carrying a heavy mountain ax on his waist.

    Behind him were more than a dozen members of the Black Tiger Gang, all armed with weapons, surrounding the entrance to the cellar.

    Further away in the shack area, Su Yu saw Shitou - being pinned to the ground by two Black Tiger Gang men. His face was bruised and blood was still oozing from the corners of his mouth.

    Next to him, Xiao He was lifted up in the air by his collar by a gang member. The little girl bit her lip and did not cry.

    Su Yu's eyes fell on the Black Tiger Gang steward, and then glanced at the injuries on Shitou's face and Xiao He's lifted figure.

    He didn't say anything, he just stood up, patted the dirt on his body, and crawled out of the cellar.

    "Is that you?"

    The steward looked Su Yu up and down, his eyes lingering on the two knives at his waist and the Frost Sword on his back for a moment, "A brother reported that there was a strange light in this area.

    Our people searched the shack area and found that there were spiritual remnants in this cellar.

    Tell me, what are you hiding down there? "

    Su Yu didn't answer his question.

    He glanced at Shi Shi, then at Xiao He, and then asked the steward: "Did you beat those two children?"

    The steward frowned: "Let me ask you something.

    These two rats are street children in the slum area. They owe me the protection money they owe me. Why don't they teach me a lesson? "

    "Protection money?"

    Su Yu's voice was very calm, "When did Blackwater City have the name of protection fee?"

    "It's your turn as an outsider to manage the rules set by the Black Tiger Gang?"

    The steward sneered, "Boy, I see you are not a local.

    If you're wise, hand over what's hidden in the cellar, and I might be able to spare your life.

    If you dare to resist——"

    Su Yu didn't wait for him to finish.

    He moved.

    Instead of rushing towards the steward, he rushed directly into the Black Tiger Gang crowd.

    After merging the Seed of Time, the speed is at least 30% faster than before. With the fourth level of physical body strengthening, the dozens of gang members on the second and third levels of Qi Refining are like static targets in his eyes.

    When he pulled out the knife from the waist of the first accomplice, the back of the knife had already hit the knee of the second accomplice; before the third man's chain was released, his knee was already pressed against the opponent's ribs; as soon as the fourth man raised the crossbow, he snatched the crossbow and smashed it into the face of the fifth man with his backhand.

    Five breaths.
title_en: Chapter 16 Return to Blackwater City and punish the Black Tiger Gang
